facts.claim: Feb. 27, 2013 at Madison Square Garden (MSG): Curry scored 54 points (passing his previous career best of 42, a career high at the time), 18 of 28 from the field, 11 of 13 from three (one shy of the NBA record), all 48 minutes; Knicks won 109-105. Box score 3PT: 11-13 (3-pointers).

Recap: Knicks stopped Curry with 1:28 to play and the score tied at 105 (Raymond Felton blocked shot); J.R. Smith's tiebreaking basket with 1:10 left; Carmelo Anthony (Melo) followed with another basket; Warriors without David Lee (suspended one game) and Andrew Bogut (back injury). Curry finished one (1) 3-pointer shy of the NBA record at the time with 11 in 13 attempts.

caption:
54 POINTS. AND WE LOST. 🎮🏀

• Feb 27, 2013, at Madison Square Garden, with no David Lee (suspended) and no Andrew Bogut (hurt)
• All 48 minutes: 54 points, 18 of 28 from the field, 11 of 13 from three (1 shy of the record then)
• Tied at 105 with 1:28 left, Raymond Felton blocks Steph
• J.R. Smith's go-ahead bucket with 1:10 left, Melo adds one more
• Knicks win 109-105

Greatest game ever in a loss? 👇
